in_sanskrit.name: Baji
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Baji एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Baji is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Bhagat', meaning 'devotee' or 'worshiper'. The name Baji is associated with Lord Vishnu, the preserver in Hindu mythology, and symbolizes wealth, prosperity, and the blessings of the deity.
